title: Culinary Art
script_graphic_directions: Graphic: Cookies card and Featured Dessert Challenge card.
Graphic: checklist builds. Show "8½ x 11" on screen.

shots.framing: B-roll: overhead shot of a banana loaf coming out of the oven.
shots.camera: Overhead, loaf slides in from frame top; light steam drift
shots.storyboard_caption: Cold open: overhead, banana loaf comes out of the oven

shots.framing: Full-screen shared title card

graphics.anim: Red band sweeps up at -9° (10 frames), shield scales 0.9→1.0, text tracks in from right 30 px

shots.transition_in: Hard cut on a music hit
shots.storyboard_caption: Shared title card (from the graphics kit)

shots.framing: Full-screen category card

graphics.title: CULINARY ART
graphics.subtitle: COOKIES · SWEET QUICK BREADS
graphics.anim: Black band wipes down at -9° (10 frames), title punches in 1.15→1.0 scale (8 frames), subtitle letter-spaces in, small logo fades in bottom right

shots.framing: Medium two-shot, P1 left, P2 right, shield logo soft on the wall behind
shots.camera: Locked off with a slow 3% push-in across the shot

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: This year, banana bread is a competition. Let's talk culinary.

graphics.anim: Red strip wipes in from left, then black bar unrolls right (8 frames); reverse to exit

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Welcome to the SoCal Classic Fine Arts explainers. This one's for bakers.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 3: Two-shot, name bars come up

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: There are two. Cookies, and the Featured Dessert Challenge.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 3: Two-shot, name bars come up

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: For 2027, the challenge is Sweet Quick Breads.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 3: Two-shot, name bars come up

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Each school can enter three students per division in each one.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 3: Two-shot, name bars come up

shots.framing: B-roll: cookies on a disposable plate
shots.camera: Overhead, slow 10° rotation of the plate

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Bring one batch. Eight to twelve cookies, all from the same recipe.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.storyboard_caption: Insert: cookies on a disposable plate

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Write the type of cookie on your recipe and your judging sheet.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 4: Insert: cookies on a disposable plate

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Individual cookies only. No bar cookies. And yes, brownies count as bar cookies.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic graphic

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Quick breads are made without yeast. Think banana bread, zucchini bread, pumpkin bread or muffins.

graphics.title: SWEET QUICK BREADS
graphics.subtitle: 1 UNCUT LOAF OR 6 MUFFINS · NO YEAST
graphics.anim: Black band wipes down at -9° (10 frames), title slides up 40 px with ease-out (12 frames), subtitle fades in 6 frames later

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Bring one standard loaf, whole and uncut. Or six standard muffins.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Glazes and add-ins are fine, as long as it's still a quick bread. No cupcakes, no cakes and no yeast breads.

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic checklist

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Make everything from scratch, by yourself. No boxed mixes and no premade dough.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Type your recipe on regular letter-size paper.

graphics.title: EVERY ENTRY
graphics.anim: Header bar slides in from left; unchecked items sit at 40% opacity; each item gets a red check pop and goes to full opacity at its build_at time (seconds from shot start)

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: In the top right corner, put the recipe name, your name, school, grade and category. Then list every ingredient and every step.

graphics.title: EVERY ENTRY
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Bring three copies of the recipe and three judging sheets. Attach a recipe to each sheet.

graphics.title: EVERY ENTRY
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Serve it neatly on a disposable plate. And check your expiration dates.

graphics.title: EVERY ENTRY
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Then get it to the right judging room before the deadline.

graphics.title: EVERY ENTRY
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Judges score flavor, baking, appearance and creativity.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: So what gets you disqualified? Fewer than three copies. Showing up late, or in the wrong room. The wrong item or count. Or anything not made from scratch.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.framing: Medium two-shot, P1 left, P2 right, shield logo soft on the wall behind
shots.camera: Locked off with a slow 3% push-in across the shot

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: From scratch. Right count. Three copies. On time.

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic end card

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Questions? Email us. The address is on your screen.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: See you February twenty-fourth through the twenty-sixth at Pacific Baptist School!

graphics.anim: Red band drops in at -9 degrees (10 frames), shield fades up, QUESTIONS? then email then dates stagger in 6 frames apart; hold, then fade to black over the last 15 frames
